entries.note: both arms broke the same rule — conditional logic in a test body
machine-graded. Cases 1 and 3 of the lint gate. Baseline invented a tag absent from the whitelist and used try/catch in a test body; the skill arm produced 537 lines with zero constitution violations

machine-graded, skill arm only. Case 1 of the lint gate (POST /api/v1/projects) re-run after #5 PR 3 aligned the templates and http-method-coverage with SKILL.md: 360 lines, zero violations, and the output uses the new forms (expect.soft(safeParse(...).success) in negative loops, the coverage-plan block, the // qase.id(N) placeholder, the dedicated 405 block). Baseline 12 is the 2026-08-11 run, not re-run. Case 3's prompt was not recorded, so it could not be repeated identically. Limits: one case, one run, today's model, subagent generator.

machine-graded, skill arm only. Lint-gate case 1 (POST /api/v1/projects) re-run for the 2.0.0 bump (#5 PR 4: env through the config module, API flows tagged @App-API, domain-subfolder paths). 334 lines, zero violations under the plugin's smoke config including the new no-process-env-outside-config rule; the output imports tokens from config/env at the 4-level depth and tags every test @App-API. Baseline 12 is the 2026-08-11 run, not re-run. Limits: one case, one run, today's model, subagent generator.

machine-graded, skill arm only, two independent runs. Lint-gate case 1 (POST /api/v1/projects) re-run for the 3.0.0 bump (#6 PR 4, #70 and its follow-up: the standard tags are lowercase, the API tag is @api and the self-review checklist requires it). 563 and 493 lines, zero violations under the plugin smoke config with the new whitelist; every test is tagged @api (15 and 14 tests; line and test counts unverified: the generated specs are not committed). Baseline not re-run: all 12 of the 2026-08-11 baseline findings were @api tag findings, which do not fire under this whitelist; a re-lint of that file under the smoke config gives 5, all from no-process-env-outside-config, a rule added after that run. Limits: one case, two runs, today's model, subagent generator, no project CLAUDE.md, so only the standard set is measured; the declared-set branch is not.

skill arm only, three runs. Lint-gate case 1 (POST /api/v1/projects) re-run for the 3.1.0 bump (#71: Qase is optional; never invent a Qase ID). Two runs were told the repo's project CLAUDE.md says it uses Qase, one that it does not. Machine-graded: zero violations each under the plugin's smoke config. Checked by hand, since no lint rule reads qase.* lines: the Qase runs open every test with qase.suite and leave qase.id commented out; the no-Qase run has no qase lines; none invents a case ID. Unverified: the generated specs (328, 302 and 332 lines) are not committed. Limits: one case, and the repo's Qase status was given in the prompt, not read from a real repo.

skill arm only, two runs. Lint-gate case 1 (POST /api/v1/projects) re-run for the 4.0.0 bump (#71: composable tags, one type tag plus suite and trait tags). Machine-graded: zero violations each under the plugin's smoke config, whose single-tag-on-test now checks the standard taxonomy. Checked by hand: every test carries @api plus @regression; in the run whose prompt said the large-payload cases are slow, one test also carries @slow and one @smoke. The prompt stated that the repo uses the standard taxonomy, so this shows the skill applies it, not that it would choose it unprompted. Unverified: the generated specs (330 and 285 lines) are not committed. Limits: one case. Measured on the text before #88 (Qase optional); #88 changes no line the lint gate reads.
